Description:
  Generate a CycloneDX 1.6 XML SBOM for a NuGet, npm, or Terraform project.

Usage:
  umbraco-sbom <project-path> [options]
  umbraco-sbom merge <sbom.xml>... [options]     Merge several SBOMs into one (see 'umbraco-sbom merge --help').

Arguments:
  <project-path>  Path to a project file (e.g., a .csproj or package.json) or a
                  directory containing the project's manifests.

Options:
  --output-file <path>          Path where the SBOM file is written. Default: ./sbom.xml
                                in the current working directory.
  --project-type <type>         The type of the scanned project, 'library' or 'application'. Written
                                to the SBOM as the project component, which Dependency-Track uses as
                                the project's classifier. Default: guessed from the manifest
                                (executables, web projects and Terraform are applications; private
                                npm packages too), otherwise library. The SBOM always includes the
                                dependency graph (direct vs. transitive).
  --help, -h                    Show this help and exit.
  --version                     Print the tool version and exit.

License policy:
  --allow-copyleft              Permit copyleft-category licenses (GPL, LGPL, AGPL, EPL, ...).
  --allow-commercial            Permit commercial-category licenses (residual: non-permissive,
                                non-copyleft, non-first-party).
  --fail-on-unknown             Strict gating on unknown licenses (default: lenient — unknowns
                                are allowed and recorded as policy-decision=allowed-via-unknown).
  --fail-on-maintenance-fee     Fail (exit 50) when a package asks for an Open Source Maintenance Fee
                                (default: they pass and are tagged OSMF in the SBOM). A matching
                                --allow-package entry exempts a package.
  --allow-package <ecosys>:<pattern>
               
[truncated]

result.stdout:
Usage:
  umbraco-sbom merge <sbom.xml>... [options]

Merges SBOMs written by umbraco-sbom into one, for a product that is scanned in several pieces.
Components are combined (a bom-ref seen twice is kept once) and the dependency graph is merged
with every input's project folded into the first input's.

Options:
  --output-file <path>        Where to write the merged SBOM. Default: ./sbom.xml
  --project-name <name>       Name the merged project instead of using the first input's.
  --project-type <type>       'library' or 'application'. Default: the first input's.
